method: One private Datadog linked worktree/output base, identical source/lock/tools. Fresh JVM and synchronous clean before every build; empty graph/outputs/action cache checked. Same remote action cache/BES; no disk cache. New binary for local and remote. One empty-cache remote toplevel primer; identical frozen local seed and remote catalog. Fresh staging cache each run. Remote backend restart and one full read/idempotent-commit warmup excluded from timers; new commit writes not warmed. Pilot excluded. Rotating three-arm minimal/toplevel measurements. Metadata proxy counts gRPC wire bytes, separate from action-cache gRPC logs.
